description: This file defines classes for integrating Composio tools within a larger application, including a tool class and a node class with methods for loading apps, actions, and connections, as well as initialization logic.

classes.name: ComposioTool
classes.description: Represents a tool for interacting with Composio applications, capable of executing actions.

classes.name: Composio_Tools
classes.description: Implements an INode for managing Composio integrations, including loading apps, actions, connections, and initialization.

methods.name: loadMethods.listApps
methods.description: Loads list of available Composio applications using API key.

methods.name: loadMethods.listActions
methods.description: Loads list of actions for a selected app.

methods.name: loadMethods.listConnections
methods.description: Loads list of active connections for a selected app.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node, validates credentials, loads app info, and sets up tools based on app authentication requirements.
